blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Philippines — A 30-year-old man was injured after a dump truck swerved into the opposite lane and rammed the side and rear of a pickup truck, which was traveling on that side of the road. The collision happened after 3 a.m. today, along the National Highway in Brgy. Calajo-an, Minglanilla town. The dump truck driver told police that he fell asleep at the wheel, which resulted in the dump truck swerving into the opposite lane.
